exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "During the time (verb in progress)".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb ている間に matches "During the time (verb in progress)".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb ている間に.
exercises.explanation: While one action is ongoing, another action happens during that time.
